title: Splashed Ink plan v2
description: What Machine Copy extracts from a painting: broad wash strokes, round pours, and lines with measured width. See docs/DATA_FORMAT.md.

source.description: Name of the image the plan was extracted from (file name without extension).

aspect.description: Width divided by height of the analysed image.

paperSeed.description: Seed of the simulated paper the copy was painted on.

dry.description: true: dragged with little water so bristle marks and gaps stay. false: laid as wet ink.

points.description: [x, y, radius, tone, dry] with x, y as fractions of the width and height, radius as a fraction of the short side, tone 0-1, dry 0-1.

radius.description: Radius of the area this pour covers, as a fraction of the short side.

seconds.description: How long the pour is held, in simulation seconds.

ink.description: Ink concentration handed to the brush. A simulation parameter that can exceed 1; it is not a tone.

points.description: [x, y, width, density, dry]. width is a fraction of the short side. density is the ink deposit density the stroke adds, not a tone (tone = 1 - exp(-1.05 * density)).

sequence.description: Every wash stroke, pour and line in painting order as a stroke-5 style sequence with width, ink and dryness added.
